metadata.description: Hand off tasks to AI agents: an OpenOrange agent works on your task on an OpenOrange server (a Sunport). Optional oo CLI for files and coding.

plugins.name: openorange
plugins.description: Hand off a task in Claude and let an OpenOrange agent work on it on an OpenOrange server (a Sunport). Check back for the status and result, or ask for changes in the same conversation. Optional: connect your own Sunport, approve Google access separately, or use the oo CLI for files and coding.
